units: Gen. R. s. 2 ברית כרותה … רוחא שָׁיְיפָא (not רוחה, רוחו) an assurance is given to the water that even during the hot season a wind shall blow.—Trnsf. (cmp. colloquial Engl. to blow) to be proud.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:9">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> (ref. to <he>גבהו</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:16">Is. III, 16</cite>) [read:] <he>דהוויין שָׁיְפָן ברומהון</he> they were proud of their high stature; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:25">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>ש׳ ברומיהון</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 42b:7">Ḥull. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>בוקא … דשָׁף מדוכתיה</he> a dislocated hip-bone; <cite ref="Chullin 54a">ib. 54ᵃ</cite>, sq.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> bot. he lamented, (<he>מיניה</he>) <he>עד דשף דעתיה</he> (Ms. H. <he>דשני</he>) until his mind slipped (from him), he lost consciousness; a. e.—<cite ref="J00712"><he>יתיב</he></cite>(<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>) <he>בי כנישתא דשף</he> the synagogue of ‘He slipped’ (away from the Temple) ‘and settled’ (in Babylonia), name of a synagogue in Nehardea (a reference to the belief that the Divine Majesty went with Israel into the Babylonian exile).
<cite ref="Megillah 29a">Meg. 29ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24b">R. Hash. 24ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 7a:1">B. Bath. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>שׁוֹף אכריסך וכ׳</he> crouch on thy belly and go in, crouch and go out, i.e. I am not bound to make the accesses to thy rooms.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 88b:9">Snh. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>שָׁיֵיף עייל שייף ונפיק וכ׳</he> he that crawls in entering, and crawls in leaving (is very humble), and studies the Law &c.
<cite ref="Zevachim 14b:16">Zeb. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>דקשָׁיֵיף מֵישַׁף</he> when he (in a sitting position) slid himself to the altar.
Sabb. 119ᵃ מְשַׁיֵּיף נורא Ar. (ed. מוֹשִׁיף Af.) fanning the fire.
